title: Bad Calls Composure (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 130bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
The call did not go your way
It happens every play
Let it go let it go
Next point matters most

[Verse 1]
Line call out you saw it in
Dont argue dont protest the spin
Walk to the line breath count three
Next point fresh and free
Vamos vamos let it pass
Uno dos tres no clash
The ref is human just like you
Next point thats what you do

[Pre-Chorus]
Let it go
Move along
Let it go
Stay strong

[Chorus]
Bad calls composure bad calls composure
Let it go let it go let it go
Bad calls composure bad calls composure
Vamos amigos no show

[Verse 2]
If you must request appeal
Calm voice ask the ref real
Was the ball in or out
No yelling no shout
Uno dos tres calm tone
Mano blanda not stone
Whatever the answer accept
The next point is your concept

[Bridge]
Holding anger at the call
Makes the next two points fall
Breath count three reset face
Ready stance back in place

[Chorus]
Bad calls composure bad calls composure
Let it go let it go let it go
Bad calls composure bad calls composure
Vamos amigos no show

[Outro]
Let it go
Next point
Let it go
Next point
